The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] '''Daltarri''' was a terrestrial world located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was covered in plant life which was the home of the plant-based [[Daltarri (species)|Daltarri]] species.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] visited the world on behalf of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], delivering plant seeds as a good-will gesture. He cut the diplomatic visit short to aid his master, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and several other Jedi who were trapped on board the [[Starcrusher (decoy)|''Starcrusher'' decoy]].
